verdicts.explanation: The paper states that HSCO's low-temperature ionic conductivity is 0.028 S•cm-1 at 40 oC, and the main text gives Ea = 0.27 eV for HSCO. The origin is experimental (this paper's impedance measurements), and the thin-film ILG/protonation synthesis matches the paper.

Supplementary Fig. 5 caption states that the proton conductivity of the ILG-induced HSCO sample at 60 oC is 0.051 S•cm-1, obtained from this paper's own equivalent-circuit fit. Material, value, unit, temperature and origin are all correct.

The introduction states that HSmNiO3 (HSNO) has a proton conductivity of ~0.01 S•cm-1 at ~500 oC, citing ref. 14 (Zhou et al.), so the value is correctly labelled literature_cited and is not a measurement from this paper. The approximate temperature is as stated in the paper.
